column3: The Hebrew first names the Wilderness of Zin and then identifies it as Kadesh; BSB makes Kadesh the camping place located in the Wilderness of Zin.
The Hebrew says Aaron went up “by the mouth of the LORD”; BSB uses “At the LORD’s command.”
The Hebrew gives Aaron’s age as “a son of one hundred and twenty-three years”; BSB says “123 years old.”
The Hebrew leaves the traveling subject unnamed; BSB supplies “the Israelites.”
The Hebrew has both “spoke” and “saying”; BSB condenses these to “said.”
The Hebrew repeats the destroying verb separately for the carved objects and cast images; BSB gives one “destroy” for both.
